title: Explain a mechanism
inputs: One concept, an example, a caveat

beats.vo: Why does a road at ninety-five percent jam, when one at seventy keeps flowing?
One driver taps the brakes. With room to spare, the gap absorbs it. Packed full, the slowdown ripples back down the line.
Queueing math says the wait grows as load over spare capacity. At ninety-five percent full, it's nineteen times the wait at half full.

props.source: Queueing theory (M/M/1): wait grows as load ÷ (1 − load)

note.text: 19 times the wait at half full

beats.vo: Full isn't efficient. Full is fragile.

props.text: Full isn't efficient. Full is fragile.

beats.vo: So plan for seventy percent, not a hundred.

props.title: Plan for 70%, not 100%.
props.support: Headroom is what absorbs the unexpected.
